title: DISTINCT reserveKeys produce two entries (STANDARD 0d + LOSS 92d)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture ENT-04 (GET /v1/provisioningentries/{id}/entries, tenant gerege, business date pinned 2026-09-01). ENT-04 observed FOUR reserve entries in one generation pass, and those four rows carry DIFFERENT (categoryId, overdueInDays) pairs: (1,0), (2,31), (3,62), (4,92). This vector transcribes the (1,0) STANDARD row (amountreserved 1066.190000 -> 106619 minor) and the (4,92) LOSS row (amountreserved 106618.530000 -> 10661853 minor) as expect_entries, and carries the two per-loan request rows already promoted by PV-05-STANDARD-RESERVE and PV-08-LOSS-RESERVE. It is the only vector whose inputs carry DIFFERENT reserveKeys, so it is the only one that can see the DISTINCT-KEY branch of GenerateReserveEntriesWith: a port that ignores the eight-field key and merges every row into one entry would still pass every single-key vector (PV-05..08) but must fail this one. Every expect entry is transcribed from the cited capture; no value was computed by this promotion.
